name: Tech Port Center + Arena

bagPolicy.summary: For most events, one clear bag up to 12 × 12 × 6 inches or a one-gallon clear bag is allowed, plus one nonclear personal item up to 5 × 8 inches. Backpacks, including clear backpacks, are prohibited; diaper and medical bags are inspected.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: Parking Lots A and B are first come first served, with advance booking or arrival payment by registered license plate. Advance booking saves 20% compared with same-day parking.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The designated drop-off and rideshare zone is in front of the building. Enter from General Hudnell Drive and exit by Van Nostrand Drive.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Concession stands and bars accept debit and major credit cards; the facility is cashless. Food service is also offered in its Provisions Food Hall and Bar.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: Guest Services provides wheelchair escorts on request from entry points and listening receivers are available from the box office with valid identification.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: The venue normally prohibits re-entry during events. For a personal emergency or to return a prohibited item to a car, speak with a Guest Services supervisor before exiting.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: Tickets are mobile through eTix and cannot normally be picked up at will call. The event-day box office opens two hours before doors; paper tickets require prior arrangement.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: The venue has metal detectors and screens bags at entry. Its box office opens two hours before doors, while the exact door time is event-specific.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

capacity: Approximately 3,200 guests, depending on concert setup
